Codex 没有返回登录地址。: Codex did not return a sign-in URL.
当前模型不支持图片，请切换模型后发送。: This model does not support images. Choose another model.
当前 Obsidian 环境没有提供录音接口，请使用桌面版或系统听写。: Recording is unavailable. Use desktop Obsidian or system dictation.
录音超过 25 MB，请缩短后重试。: Recording exceeds 25 MB. Try a shorter recording.
录音中断，请检查麦克风设备后重试。: Recording stopped unexpectedly. Check your microphone.
麦克风访问未获授权。请在系统设置中允许 Obsidian 使用麦克风。: Microphone access denied. Allow Obsidian in system settings.
没有找到麦克风，请连接设备后重试。: No microphone found. Connect one and try again.
无法读取麦克风，设备可能正被其他应用占用。: Microphone unavailable. Another app may be using it.
当前会话尚未收到 Codex 的用量数据。完成一次请求后会自动更新。: No usage report yet. It updates after a request.
显示本插件连接获得的信息；这不是 ChatGPT 账户的剩余额度或账单。: Connection information, not your remaining ChatGPT quota or bill.
语音输入使用本机 Codex 的 ChatGPT 登录。完成录音后，音频会发送到: Dictation uses your local Codex ChatGPT sign-in. Audio is uploaded for transcription, then text is added to your draft.
macOS：在「系统设置 → 键盘 → 听写」开启听写，回到输入框，按你设置的听: macOS: enable Dictation in System Settings → Keyboard, then use your dictation shortcut in the input.
Windows：先聚焦输入框，再按 Win + H。: Windows: focus the input and press Win + H.
如果转写服务暂时不可用，可以先使用系统听写。插件不会自动切换到额外付费的 API: If transcription is unavailable, use system dictation. There is no automatic switch to a paid API.
Codex 需要桌面版本的本地笔记库。: Codex requires a local vault in desktop Obsidian.
请先在笔记中选中一些文字。: Select some text in a note first.
连接本机 Codex，沿用 Codex 的账户与模型服务配置。: Connect to local Codex using its account and provider configuration.
留空自动查找；也可以填写完整路径。修改后点击重新连接。: Leave empty to detect automatically, or enter a full path and reconnect.
启用插件后自动启动本地 Codex 连接。: Automatically connect to local Codex when the plugin starts.
如果本机 Codex 已经登录，无需重复登录。: Already signed in to local Codex? No need to sign in again.
Codex 消息过大，连接已关闭。: Codex message too large. Connection closed.
Codex 返回了无效的协议消息。: Codex returned an invalid protocol message.
找不到 Codex。请安装 Codex CLI，或在插件设置中填写 Codex: Codex not found. Install Codex CLI or set its full executable path in plugin settings.
录音超过 25 MB，请缩短录音。: Recording exceeds 25 MB. Record a shorter clip.
语音输入需要本机 Codex 登录 ChatGPT；API Key 登录不能复用: Dictation requires local Codex signed in to ChatGPT. API key sign-in is not supported for dictation.
Codex 登录已失效，请重新登录 ChatGPT。: Codex sign-in expired. Sign in to ChatGPT again.
转写服务拒绝了请求，请确认当前账户可以使用桌面端听写。: Transcription denied. Check whether your account supports desktop dictation.
录音过大，请缩短后重试。: Recording too large. Try a shorter clip.
语音转写暂时达到使用限制，请稍后重试。: Dictation usage limit reached. Try again later.
没有识别到语音，请靠近麦克风后重试。: No speech detected. Move closer to the microphone.
无法连接语音转写服务，请检查网络和 Codex 登录状态。: Could not connect to transcription. Check your network and Codex sign-in.
在笔记库内工作；需要额外权限时，向你请求批准。: Work in the vault; ask you for additional permissions.
需要额外权限时，由 Codex 检查风险并决定是否批准。: Codex reviews requests for additional permissions.
无需逐次批准，可访问笔记库外文件、使用网络并执行命令。: Access files outside the vault, use the network, and run commands without individual approvals.
保留旧版本的只读设置；修改文件时需要额外授权。: Legacy read-only setting; edits require additional permission.
想在笔记里做些什么？: What would you like to do with your notes?
从一个想法、一篇笔记，或一个问题开始。: Start with an idea, a note, or a question.
请梳理这篇笔记的结构，提炼核心观点。: Organize this note and summarize its key ideas.
帮我在笔记库中寻找相关笔记，整理它们之间的联系。: Find related notes in my vault and explain their connections.
我想写一篇新笔记，请先帮我构思大纲。: Help me outline a new note.
请先在本机 Codex 登录 ChatGPT，再使用语音输入。: Sign in to ChatGPT in local Codex before using dictation.
笔记超过 250 KB，请选择部分内容，或直接让 Codex 按文件路径读取。: Note exceeds 250 KB. Select a section or ask Codex to read its path.
当前保留旧版只读设置。选择以上模式后才会变更。: Legacy read-only mode is preserved until you choose another mode.
连接 Codex 后加载可用模型与强度。: Connect Codex to load models and reasoning levels.
请先停止当前回复，再切换对话。: Stop the current response before switching chats.
发送状态尚未确认，请先检查连接。: Send not confirmed. Check the connection first.
搜索笔记、文本文件或图片…: Search notes, text files, or images…
此版本尚不支持交互：{method}。本次请求未获批准。: Unsupported interaction: {method}. The request was not approved.
{method} 请求超时。请检查连接后重试。: {method} timed out. Check the connection and try again.
模型上下文容量：{capacity}。会话累计用量不等于当前上下文占用；推理输出: Context capacity: {capacity}. Session totals differ from current context usage; reasoning tokens are part of output.
当前录音接口：{status}。首次使用需要允许 Obsidian 访问麦克风。: Recording: {status}. Allow Obsidian microphone access on first use.
默认跟随 Obsidian；只改变插件界面，不翻译已有对话。: Follow Obsidian by default. Changes the interface, not existing conversations.
选择发送快捷键；Shift+Enter 始终换行。: Choose how to send. Shift+Enter always inserts a newline.
选择聊天面板的位置；已打开的面板会移动并保留草稿。: Choose where chat opens. Moves an open panel while keeping its draft.
回复时跟随到底部；向上阅读时暂停跟随。: Follow replies at the bottom. Pause when you scroll up to read.
本笔记库的长期要求，例如回复语言、写作风格和笔记格式。修改后从下一次发送起生效。: Lasting preferences for this vault, such as reply language, style, and note format. Applies from the next send.
例如：默认用中文回答，先给结论，保留笔记中的双向链接。: For example: reply in English, lead with the conclusion, and preserve wikilinks.
默认沿用本机 Codex 配置。修改后从下一次发送起生效，实际效果取决于模型支持: Default uses local Codex settings. Applies from the next send; requires model support.
对话与偏好保存在本笔记库的插件数据中；Codex 也保存会话记录。麦克风录音完成: Chats and preferences are saved in this vault's plugin data; Codex also keeps session records. Audio is uploaded for transcription. Authentication tokens and recordings are not stored by the plugin.
面板正在移动，请稍后重试。: The panel is moving. Try again shortly.
请先结束语音输入，再移动面板。: Finish dictation before moving the panel.
无法在所选位置打开面板。: Could not open the panel in that position.
